integrity: All-length proof is self-contained in RESULT.md; two finite verification scripts independently corroborate its explicit threshold and witness identities. No claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the standard two-letter direct product C_n × C_3 for n at least 4, not arbitrary common-reset pairs. Finite cases through n=11 and the divisible branch are pre-existing results. No count of all shortest common reset words is asserted. An unindexed equivalent result remains a priority risk.
title: A sharp modulo-three synchronization law for products of Černý automata
